description: Get the form of a player by providing their player ID: results against what their Elo rating predicted. Returns expected and actual win rate, the delta between them and matches played over the window (last 180 days by default), the same values by month with their trend (rising, stable or declining), rolling windows of the last 7, 30 and 90 days, the same window one year earlier, the current win or loss streak, and the record in third sets and tiebreaks. To get the player ID, use the "search-players" tool.

after_date.description: Start of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 180 days before before_date.

before_date.description: End of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

level.description: Filter by tournament level(s), comma-separated. Premier Padel: major, p1, p2, finals. FIP tour: fip_platinum, fip_gold, fip_silver, fip_other. World Padel Tour (historical): wpt_master, wpt_1000, wpt_500, wpt_final. Padel Pro Tour (historical): ppt_master, ppt_final, ppt_international, ppt_promotional, ppt_other.

player_id.description: The ID of the player to get the form for.

round.description: Filter by match round (1 = Final, 2 = Semifinal, 4 = Quarterfinal, 8 = Round of 16, 16 = Round of 32, 32 = Round of 64).

name: show-player-form
